integrity: Exact algebraic analysis with transparent known-method attribution; no independent validation or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only local linear stability of the specified community-matrix family is established.
The same fixed positive equilibrium can be realized in Lotka–Volterra equations only by also varying the intrinsic growth vector as the link strength changes.
No claim about global attraction, nonlinear bifurcating orbits, or actual ecological persistence.
A classical forest-stability theorem is used as prior knowledge, not claimed as original.
Complete-text comparison to particularly relevant 1979 and 1987 three-species loop studies is unresolved; broader prior coverage remains possible.
title: A two-mechanism reentrant stability law for a three-species antagonistic feedback loop
